name: Mermaid Canvas
tagline: Create, save and render Mermaid.js diagrams
description: A tool that allows character personas to design, save, edit, and render interactive Mermaid.js flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and architecture graphs. Actions: save_diagram (needs name, code, render), read_diagram (needs name), list_diagrams, delete_diagram (needs name).

code.description: The raw Mermaid diagram syntax (required for save_diagram).

render.description: Whether to render the diagram as a PNG using QuickChart (optional, defaults to true).
